tip: は = 'as for X' (what we are talking about). が = the one that does it or exists, especially when that is new information or the answer to who? / what?
ex: たなかさん.は きます。|(As for) Mr Tanaka, he's coming.
たなかさん.が きます。|Mr Tanaka is the one coming.

tip: に = where something IS or ARRIVES. で = where an action is DONE.
ex: いえ.に います。|I'm at home.
いえ.で たべます。|I eat at home.

tip: に = arriving at. へ = heading toward. For destinations both work; に is more common in speech. For receivers, times and existence only に works.
ex: なら.に いきます。|I'll go to Nara.
なら.へ いきます。|I'll head for Nara.

tip: を = the thing acted on. が = the doer, or what exists / is liked / is understood. あります, います, すきです, わかります take が.
ex: おちゃ.を のみます。|I drink tea.
おちゃ.が すきです。|I like tea.

tip: を = the object of the action. に = the destination or receiver. Go TO a place = に; leave or pass through a place = を.
ex: いえ.に かえります。|I'll go home.
いえ.を でます。|I'll leave the house.

tip: と = together, both sides (chat with). に = one way, toward one person (tell).
ex: ともだち.と はなします。|I'll chat with a friend.
ともだち.に はなします。|I'll tell a friend.

tip: と = with a person. で = by means of something, or at a place.
ex: ともだち.と いきます。|I'll go with a friend.
バス.で いきます。|I'll go by bus.

tip: から = start. まで = end. Together they make a span, and each is its own chunk.
ex: くじ.から ごじ.まで はたらきます。|I work from nine to five.

tip: も replaces は, が and を. Never stack them (no はも, をも). After に, で, と, へ, から, まで, add it: でも, にも.
ex: わたし.も いきます。|I'm going too.
なら.でも かいます。|I buy it in Nara too.

tip: Clock times and days of the week take に. Relative time words (あした, いま, らいしゅう, まいにち) take nothing.
ex: さんじ.に きます。|I'll come at three.
あした きます。|I'll come tomorrow.

tip: Time words need no tag. Add は only to make them the topic: 'as for tomorrow…'.
ex: あした.は やすみです。|Tomorrow is a day off.
